history.summary: (flag) Identity uncertain: several Venkateswara shrines exist in the Hosur region - the Sri Lakshmi Venkataramana Swamy Temple in Venkatesh Nagar behind the Titan Factory (Hosur-635109), the Sri Kalyana Venkatesa Perumal Temple in Gokul Nagar, and the 'Dhakshina Tirupati'/'Chinna Tirupati' hill temple at Gopasandram, Kamandoddi on the Ponnaiyar river. The CSV row names only a generic 'Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple' in Hosur; this file documents the geocoder's exact-name best match, the Lakshmi Venkateswara Swamy Temple at Kurinji Nagar Extension, SIPCOT, Hosur 635126 - a modern neighbourhood shrine for which no published history, built date or festival record was found. (flag) CSV 'state' column wrongly reads 'Hosur' - corrected to Tamil Nadu. (flag) media left empty: targeted image searches returned no verified photograph of this temple.

name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple
town_description: Hosur is an industrial city in Krishnagiri district of northern Tamil Nadu, about 40 km from Bengaluru on NH 44. A former fort town under Chola, Hoysala and Vijayanagara rule, it is now a manufacturing centre with several Perumal/Venkateswara shrines in and around the town.

travel.road: In the SIPCOT industrial area off NH 44 (Bangalore-Chennai highway).

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Vaikuntha Ekadasi (Dec-Jan) for Perumal temples
